cases.title: Certificate of Final Adoption Order
cases.issuing_authority: Ontario Superior Court of Justice - Family Court Division

fields.issuing_court_jurisdiction: Ontario Superior Court of Justice, Toronto, Ontario, Canada
fields.proof_of_relationship: Legal Adoption Certificate and Final Court Order
fields.legal_guardianship_status: Full Legal Adoption (Parental Rights Fully Transferred)
fields.issuing_jurisdiction_accreditation: Accredited Hague Adoption Convention Jurisdiction & Ministry Approved

narrative_blocks: This Certificate of Final Adoption Order confirms that Liam Doe was legally adopted by Jane Doe and John Smith pursuant to the Order of the Ontario Superior Court of Justice dated May 10, 2023.

All statutory requirements under the Child, Youth and Family Services Act, including approved home study assessments, valid biological parent consent, and Ministry clearance, have been fully satisfied.

cases.title: Civil Status Registry Birth Extract

fields.issuing_jurisdiction_accreditation: Accredited Hague Adoption Convention Jurisdiction & Ministry Approved

narrative_blocks: This extract from the Civil Status Registry certifies the birth registration entry for Alex Doe naming Jane Doe and John Smith.
Note: This document represents an administrative registration record from the civil registry and does not constitute a judicial court adoption order.

defect_spec.description: The submission contains a civil registration extract instead of the required complete final court adoption order issued by a judicial authority.

cases.title: Temporary Legal Guardianship Order
cases.issuing_authority: Family Court of the First Instance

fields.issuing_court_jurisdiction: Family Court of the First Instance, Region 2
fields.proof_of_relationship: Temporary Custody Designation and Legal Guardianship Order
fields.issuing_jurisdiction_accreditation: Accredited Hague Adoption Convention Jurisdiction & Ministry Approved

narrative_blocks: This order grants temporary legal custody and guardianship of Morgan Doe to Jane Doe and John Smith for a period of two years.
The biological parents retain ultimate legal parental rights and obligations. This document does not constitute a decree of final legal adoption.

defect_spec.description: A temporary legal guardianship or custody order was submitted in place of a full legal adoption order, failing to establish full and permanent legal adoption status.

cases.title: Foreign Local Adoption Certificate
cases.issuing_authority: District Civil Tribunal of Foreign Region

fields.issuing_jurisdiction_accreditation: Non-Accredited Foreign Local Jurisdiction (No Provincial Endorsement)

narrative_blocks: This foreign local adoption certificate records the adoption of Taylor Doe by Jane Doe and John Smith under local municipal laws.
The adoption was finalized in a non-accredited jurisdiction without obtaining a Letter of No Objection or clearance from the provincial adoption authority.

defect_spec.description: The adoption took place in a non-accredited foreign jurisdiction without obtaining the mandatory Letter of No Objection or clearance from the provincial adoption authority.

cases.title: Certificate of Private Adoption Decree

fields.issuing_jurisdiction_accreditation: Accredited Hague Adoption Convention Jurisdiction & Ministry Approved

narrative_blocks: This decree records a private arrangement for the adoption of Jordan Doe by Jane Doe and John Smith.
The record lacks verifiable biological parent consent documentation and an independent home study report or best-interests determination.

defect_spec.description: The adoption record lacks verified biological parent consent and an independent home study evaluation, giving rise to doubts regarding authenticity and best-interests compliance.
